evidence.excerpt: LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert.
